candidate.answerReason: Dividing each of the nine terms by 9 turns the mean into 1+11+111+⋯+111111111=123456789. Its missing digit is 0.

methods.label: Divide by 9 before adding
methods.explanation:
The mean is the sum of the nine numbers divided by \(9\). Dividing each term by \(9\) first makes the addition simpler:
\[
\begin{aligned}
M&=\frac99+\frac{99}{9}+\cdots+\frac{999999999}{9}\\
 &=1+11+111+\cdots+111111111.
\end{aligned}
\]
Each quotient consists entirely of ones. In their sum, the ones column contains nine ones, the tens column contains eight ones, and each successive column contains one fewer. No column sum exceeds \(9\), so there are no carries. Reading the resulting digits from left to right gives
\[
M=123456789.
\]
Its digits are \(1\) through \(9\), so the missing digit is \(0\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
methods.levelReason: The solution uses the arithmetic-mean definition, distributivity, and decimal column addition, without sequence-sum formulas.
